# AstryxField { #anylumino.AstryxField }

```python
AstryxField(
    children=None,
    *,
    label,
    input_id='',
    description='',
    status=None,
    disabled=False,
    **props,
)
```

Wrap a custom control with an Astryx field label.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default    |
|-------------|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| children    | ChildInput                  | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `None`     |
| label       | str                         | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | _required_ |
| input_id    | str                         | ID associated with the wrapped input element.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `''`       |
| description | str                         | Supporting description text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `''`       |
| status      | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None | Validation or status record displayed by Astryx.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `None`     |
| disabled    | bool                        | Whether the component should render disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `False`    |
| **props     | Any                         | JSON-safe Field props. Useful keys: isLabelHidden, descriptionID, isOptional, isRequired, labelIcon, labelTooltip, statusVariant, width, className, and style. anylumino manages label, inputID, description, status, disabled state, and child content. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Field>. | `{}`       |
